title: afm flow
description: Schema for an afm flow.yaml — a multi-stage AI task description. See https://akopichin.github.io/afm/flow-reference/

prompt.description: Shared instruction added to the system prompt of every stage and phase.

max_parallel.description: Maximum number of stages running in parallel (0 = unlimited).

root_dir.description: Project root = agents' working directory. A relative path is resolved from the afm root (--dir); empty inherits the afm process CWD.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks: observer commands receiving event JSON on stdin (flow layer, gets all stages' events).

verifyRunStep.description: A verify step that runs a shell command.

run.description: Shell command for this verify step.

verifyCommandStep.description: A verify step delegated to an agent (e.g. codex).

command.description: Agent alias that performs this verify step (e.g. codex).

prompt.description: Extra criteria for the verify agent.

memory.description: Agent-memory configuration. A non-empty `path` enables the feature.

path.description: Directory (relative to root_dir) where memory files live. A non-empty value enables agent memory.

mode.description: Lifecycle of the shared memory.md: r (read-only), w (write-only), rw (both). Default rw.

memory_use.description: Master switch for READING memory into stage prompts. Default false.

max_rules.description: Maximum number of patterns kept per file. Default 25.

commit.description: Git-commit the memory directory at the end of the run (never pushes). Default false.

stage.description: A single stage. Must have at least one of: a planning agent, `plan`, `interactive: true`, `agents: [auto]`, or `script`.

id.description: Unique identifier. Must be a safe path component (no '/', '\', '.', '..', or NUL).

name.description: Human-readable name for logs and the dashboard.

agents.description: Agent phases: any combination of planning/implementation/review (plus custom command names), OR exactly [auto] for the autonomous track.

anyOf.description: A custom agent command name (counts as the implementation phase).

skills.description: Claude skills made available to the agent.

depends_on.description: IDs of stages that must complete first.

eager_planning.description: Start planning immediately when the flow runs, without waiting for depends_on.

plan.description: Path to a ready-made plan file (skips the planning agent).

command.description: AI command for this stage (overrides client.command).

max_parallel.description: Limit on parallel stages using this command.

artifacts.description: Files this stage produces for other stages.

interactive.description: Enable the file-based dialog protocol with the user via the dashboard.

verify.description: Stage-completion check(s) run after .done: a shell command (legacy scalar), one step object ({run: ...} or {command: ...}), or an ordered list of step objects. A non-zero shell exit means the stage is not actually complete.

oneOf.description: Several verify steps run in order.

prompt.description: Explicit instruction delivered to the agent after the stage context block.

script.description: Run this shell script instead of an AI agent. Mutually exclusive with agents/command/interactive/plan/verify.

script_before.description: Shell script run immediately before the stage's own content.

script_after.description: Shell script run right after the stage completes.

auto_approve.description: Approve this stage's plan automatically the instant it's ready (for CI).

auto_run.description: false pauses the stage at its first activation until you click Continue. Default true.

buttons.description: Predefined kebab-menu actions: label -> canned prompt delivered to the live agent.

memory_use.description: Override the flow-level memory.memory_use for this stage (controls reading only).

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks scoped to this stage. Flow-level events are not allowed here.

path.description: File path; './' is relative to the stage directory in the run.

inline.description: true (default) inlines the file contents into the prompt; false passes the path instead.

input.description: An artifact consumed from a dependency: either the string "stage.artifact" or an object.

optional.description: If true, the stage runs even if the file is missing.

reflect.description: Opts the stage into agent memory. Requires the flow-level memory: block.

file.description: The stage's own memory file, relative to memory.path. Absolute paths, '..' segments, and the reserved project file memory.md are not allowed.

mode.description: Access mode for this stage's file: r/w/rw. Default rw.

lifecycleHook.description: A lifecycle hook: an observer command that receives the event JSON payload on stdin. Its exit status never affects the flow.

id.description: Unique hook id within its layer; also the hook log file name (must be a safe path component).

command.description: The command line, run via `sh -c` with the event JSON payload on stdin.

retries.description: Extra retry attempts after a non-zero exit. Default 0 (single attempt).

env.description: Hook process env: target var -> env:NAME | file:PATH source reference

inherit_env.description: Inherit the whole afm process environment. Default false (minimal env).

lifecycleEventSelector.description: Either the scalar "all", or a non-empty list of event names (validated by afm at load time).
